cues.en: Now that you have some intuition for what the correlation means, I'm now going to tell you about the formula for the correlation.
cues.zh: 你現在對相關的意義已經有一些直覺，接著我要介紹相關的公式。

cues.en: But before that I'm going to tell you about a related concept and that is called the covariance.
cues.zh: 但在那之前，先介紹一個相關概念，叫作共變異數。

cues.en: You may have heard this term before.
cues.zh: 你可能聽過這個詞。

cues.en: Covariance.
cues.zh: 共變異數。

cues.en: And maybe you're wondering what is the difference between covariance and correlation.
cues.zh: 也許你想知道，共變異數與相關有什麼差別。

cues.en: Well you're in luck.
cues.zh: 你很幸運。

cues.en: I'm going to tell you exactly the answer in this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片就會給你確切的答案。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: What is the difference between covariance and correlation?
cues.zh: 共變異數與相關有什麼差別？

cues.en: Let me start by giving a description of a covariance.
cues.zh: 先說明共變異數。

cues.en: A covariance is a single number that measures the linear relationship between two variables.
cues.zh: 共變異數是衡量兩個變數線性關係的一個數值。

cues.en: Now that sounds an awful lot like correlation, don't you think?
cues.zh: 這聽起來是不是非常像相關？

cues.en: In fact, it is.
cues.zh: 事實上，確實如此。

cues.en: And in fact, to compute a correlation, you first have to compute the covariance.
cues.zh: 而且，計算相關時，必須先計算共變異數。

cues.en: And then you just normalize that covariance suitably as I'll show you in a moment.
cues.zh: 再用適當方式將共變異數正規化，稍後會示範。

cues.en: And that gives you the correlation.
cues.zh: 如此就得到相關。

cues.en: So in fact, a correlation coefficient is nothing more than a covariance coefficient that has been suitably scaled.
cues.zh: 因此，相關係數其實就是經過適當縮放的共變異數係數。

cues.en: And in particular it's scaled to between minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 具體來說，是縮放到負 1 到正 1 之間。

cues.en: So you know from the previous video that a correlation varies between minus one and plus one and zero is in the middle meaning no a zero correlation.
cues.zh: 上一支影片提過，相關介於負 1 到正 1，0 在中間，表示沒有——也就是零相關。

cues.en: And a covariance on the other hand, also has zero at the middle, indicating zero covariance.
cues.zh: 另一方面，共變異數的中央也是 0，表示零共變異數。

cues.en: But covariance can go from negative to positive.
cues.zh: 不過共變異數可以從負值到正值。

cues.en: I probably should have said this to be y.
cues.zh: 其實，現在看來，我大概應該把這裡改成 Y，

cues.en: Actually, now that I look at it, to show that the negative extreme of covariance does not have to be just the the flipped sign of the positive extreme of the covariance.
cues.zh: 表示共變異數的負向極值，不一定只是正向極值換個符號而已。

cues.en: Now, the main difference between covariance and correlation is that covariance is in the same scale as the original data.
cues.zh: 共變異數與相關的主要差別，在於共變異數與原始資料採用相同尺度。

cues.en: And correlation is normalized so that it's independent of the of the data scale.
cues.zh: 而相關經過正規化，因此不受資料尺度影響。

cues.en: So for example, let's say we are looking at the linear relationship between two variables.
cues.zh: 例如，我們研究兩個變數之間的線性關係。

cues.en: Let's say it's distances.
cues.zh: 假設是距離。

cues.en: And we measure distances in miles.
cues.zh: 以英里量測距離。

cues.en: So now the covariance is going to be in units of miles whereas the correlation doesn't have any units.
cues.zh: 那麼共變異數的單位就是英里，而相關沒有單位。

cues.en: Now if we would change the data let's say we convert the data from miles into nanometers.
cues.zh: 如果改變資料，例如把英里換算成奈米，

cues.en: So now the covariance is going to be way, way, way, way, way larger because there's like a huge number of nanometers inside a mile.
cues.zh: 共變異數就會變得非常非常大，因為一英里裡面有極大量的奈米。

cues.en: So the covariance is going to change a lot because the data scale has changed.
cues.zh: 因此，資料尺度改變，共變異數也會大幅改變。

cues.en: But the correlation won't change at all because the correlation is always normalized.
cues.zh: 但相關完全不會改變，因為相關總是經過正規化。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that's the only difference between a covariance and a correlation.
cues.zh: 這就是共變異數與相關唯一的差別。

cues.en: So now let's make this more concrete.
cues.zh: 接著讓概念更具體。

cues.en: Let's make this more mathematical by showing you the formula For covariance.
cues.zh: 透過共變異數的公式，讓說明更數學化。

cues.en: So we're going to start with the formula for covariance.
cues.zh: 先從共變異數公式開始。

cues.en: And then you'll see how it gets adapted to the formula for correlation.
cues.zh: 你會看到它如何改成相關公式。

cues.en: So we have that the covariance between two variables x and y is one divided by n minus one.
cues.zh: 兩個變數 X 與 Y 的共變異數，是 1 除以 N 減 1，

cues.en: And I'll get back to this in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後會回頭解釋，

cues.en: Why this is n minus one.
cues.zh: 為什麼這裡是 N 減 1。

cues.en: The sum over basically each element in x times each element in y.
cues.zh: 再乘上各個 X 元素與各個 Y 元素相乘的總和。

cues.en: And then it just gets mean centered.
cues.zh: 不過要先做平均中心化。

cues.en: So it's x I minus the mean of x times y I.
cues.zh: 也就是 Xᵢ 減掉 X 的平均值，再乘上 Yᵢ，

cues.en: So the ith index the ith element in y minus the mean of y.
cues.zh: 也就是 Y 的第 i 個元素，減去 Y 的平均值。

cues.en: So we could simplify this expression a little bit by just imagining that the data vectors are already mean centered.
cues.zh: 如果想像資料向量已經完成平均中心化，這個式子就能稍微簡化。

cues.en: So you've already subtracted the mean from variables x and variable y.
cues.zh: 也就是已經從變數 X 與變數 Y 中減掉各自的平均值。

cues.en: And then the the covariance is simply the sum of all of the element wise multiplications between x and y.
cues.zh: 那麼，共變異數就是 X 與 Y 逐元素相乘的結果加總。

cues.en: Now if you've had some linear algebra exposure.
cues.zh: 如果你接觸過一些線性代數，

cues.en: You might recognize this as being the dot product or very close to the dot product.
cues.zh: 可能會認出這是內積，或非常接近內積。

cues.en: So the dot product is an operation in linear algebra that involves element wise multiplication between two vectors and then the sum.
cues.zh: 內積是一種線性代數運算：將兩個向量逐元素相乘，再把結果相加。

cues.en: So that's literally what this is.
cues.zh: 這裡做的正是這件事。

cues.en: We have element wise multiplication and then sum.
cues.zh: 先逐元素相乘，再求和。

cues.en: Now it's a little bit beyond the dot product because we are also subtracting the mean.
cues.zh: 不過又比內積多一點，因為還減掉平均值。

cues.en: And we're dividing by n minus one.
cues.zh: 並且除以 N 減 1。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So why do we divide by n minus one and why not one over n.
cues.zh: 為什麼要除以 N 減 1，而不是除以 N？

cues.en: Well I would like you to think about this.
cues.zh: 希望你想一想。

cues.en: Pause the video and think about, based on the formula that you see here, why white might we normalize by n minus one.
cues.zh: 暫停影片，根據這裡的公式，想想為什麼要用 N 減 1 正規化。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Did you figure it out.
cues.zh: 你想出來了嗎？

cues.en: So the answer is that we have a parameter here that we're subtracting.
cues.zh: 答案是，這裡減去了一個參數。

cues.en: We're subtracting the mean from x and from y.
cues.zh: 我們從 X 與 Y 中減掉平均值。

cues.en: And so that takes away one degree of freedom.
cues.zh: 因此會少掉一個自由度。

cues.en: Because now once we know n minus one elements in x and n minus one elements in y the last element.
cues.zh: 因為一旦知道 X 中 N 減 1 個元素，以及 Y 中 N 減 1 個元素，最後一個元素，

cues.en: The nth element in X or in y is going to be entirely determined.
cues.zh: 也就是 X 或 Y 的第 N 個元素，就完全確定了。

cues.en: It's no longer free, so we have n minus one.
cues.zh: 它不再自由，所以是 N 減 1。

cues.en: Now this is actually just a normalization factor.
cues.zh: 這其實只是一個正規化因子。

cues.en: To compute a covariance you really need to have this part.
cues.zh: 計算共變異數時，真正需要的是這一部分。

cues.en: This part dividing by n minus one is not as critical in some cases.
cues.zh: 某些情況下，除以 N 減 1 這一部分並非那麼關鍵。

cues.en: It depends on what you're doing with the covariance.
cues.zh: 這取決於你要用共變異數做什麼。

cues.en: But it's good to to keep this in the formula anyway.
cues.zh: 但還是把它保留在公式中比較好。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this is how to compute covariance.
cues.zh: 這就是共變異數的計算方式。

cues.en: Now I told you on the previous slide that the correlation coefficient is nothing more than a covariance that is suitably normalized.
cues.zh: 上一張投影片提到，相關係數其實就是經過適當正規化的共變異數。

cues.en: So to compute a correlation here's the formula.
cues.zh: 以下是計算相關的公式。

cues.en: It looks like there's a lot of stuff going on.
cues.zh: 看起來好像有很多東西。

cues.en: But I'm going to break it down.
cues.zh: 不過我會逐步拆解。

cues.en: You'll see.
cues.zh: 你會看到，

cues.en: This is all actually pretty simple pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 其實全部都很簡單、很直接。

cues.en: So first of all notice that the numerator is exactly the covariance.
cues.zh: 首先注意，分子正是共變異數。

cues.en: Well almost exactly.
cues.zh: 或者說，幾乎完全一樣。

cues.en: We don't have this one over n minus one factor here.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有 1 除以 N 減 1 這個因子。

cues.en: I will tell you why in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後會解釋原因。

cues.en: But otherwise the numerator of the correlation coefficient is exactly the same thing as the covariance formula.
cues.zh: 除此之外，相關係數的分子與共變異數公式完全相同。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So then what do we have in the denominator.
cues.zh: 那分母有什麼？

cues.en: Well we have it's pretty similar to the numerator except it's broken up.
cues.zh: 與分子很類似，不過拆開了。

cues.en: So we have the sum of the x's squared and the sums of the y's squared.
cues.zh: 有 X 平方的總和，以及 Y 平方的總和。

cues.en: And then we have the and then they multiply each other.
cues.zh: 然後將兩者相乘。

cues.en: And then we take the square root of all of that.
cues.zh: 最後對整個結果開平方根。

cues.en: So to think about why this is the right normalization I would like you to think about first, you know, not looking at the formula for right now.
cues.zh: 要理解為什麼這樣正規化才對，我希望你先暫時不看公式。

cues.en: Let's just think about what would happen if we would correlate a variable with itself.
cues.zh: 先想想，一個變數與它自己計算相關，會發生什麼事？

cues.en: So we know that a variable with itself is perfectly correlated obviously.
cues.zh: 顯然，一個變數與自己完全相關。

cues.en: So therefore the correlation coefficient between a variable and itself should be one.
cues.zh: 因此，一個變數與自己的相關係數應該是 1。

cues.en: It should be exactly one.
cues.zh: 應該精確等於 1。

cues.en: So let's think that through now applying that to this formula.
cues.zh: 現在把這個想法套用到公式中。

cues.en: So we want to correlate a variable with itself.
cues.zh: 我們要計算一個變數與自己的相關。

cues.en: So let's imagine that x equals y.
cues.zh: 所以假設 X 等於 Y。

cues.en: So x and y are just different labels for exactly the same thing.
cues.zh: X 和 Y 只是同一個東西的不同標籤。

cues.en: So that means that this is x I minus x bar times x I minus x bar which really means x I minus x bar.
cues.zh: 這裡就變成 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值，乘上 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值，也就是 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值，

cues.en: And then that quantity squared which is exactly what we have here.
cues.zh: 再將這個量平方，正好就是這裡的式子。

cues.en: So this becomes the sum of x minus x bar squared.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡變成 X 減 X 平均值的平方再加總。

cues.en: This becomes x I minus x bar squared which it already is.
cues.zh: 這裡變成 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值的平方，本來就已經是如此。

cues.en: And this is also x minus x bar squared.
cues.zh: 這裡也變成 X 減 X 平均值的平方。

cues.en: So then we get two of these x bar squared terms and they multiply each other.
cues.zh: 於是得到兩個這樣的平方項，彼此相乘。

cues.en: So this term here under our imaginary scenario where x equals y is exactly equal to this term.
cues.zh: 在我們假設 X 等於 Y 的情況下，這一項與這一項完全相等。

cues.en: So they multiply each other.
cues.zh: 兩者相乘。

cues.en: But then we take the square root which means we actually just get rid of one of them.
cues.zh: 接著開平方根，實際上就相當於去掉其中一個。

cues.en: So then we end up with x I x I minus x bar squared.
cues.zh: 最後得到 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值的平方，

cues.en: And that sum divided by exactly the same thing.
cues.zh: 它的總和，再除以完全相同的量。

cues.en: So we end up with the same term in the numerator and the denominator.
cues.zh: 所以分子與分母最後是相同的項。

cues.en: So again if that was a little difficult to follow then you can work this through on your own on a piece of paper.
cues.zh: 如果剛才有點難跟上，可以自己拿張紙推算。

cues.en: Essentially just replace all the y's with x's.
cues.zh: 基本上只要把所有 Y 換成 X。

cues.en: And you will find that this equation ends up being something over itself.
cues.zh: 就會發現，這個公式最後變成某個量除以它自己。

cues.en: And that gives us a value of one.
cues.zh: 因此得到 1。

cues.en: So that's the maximum possible correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這就是相關係數可能的最大值。

cues.en: Two variables are perfectly correlated.
cues.zh: 兩個變數完全相關。

cues.en: They equal one or the correlation coefficient equals one.
cues.zh: 它們等於 1，或者說相關係數等於 1。

cues.en: And so that's why that's one way to see why this normalization is the right thing to do.
cues.zh: 這是理解為什麼這種正規化方式正確的一種方法。

cues.en: Now with just one point about this missing one over n minus one here, let's just for convenience call this term b.
cues.zh: 再談談這裡少掉的 1 除以 N 減 1。為了方便，把這一項稱為 b。

cues.en: So we're going to say b equals one divided by n minus one okay.
cues.zh: 也就是 b 等於 1 除以 N 減 1。

cues.en: So now you know you might be thinking well there should be a B in here to normalize this okay.
cues.zh: 你可能會想，這裡應該有一個 b，用來正規化。

cues.en: And then there should be another B in here to normalize this.
cues.zh: 接著這裡應該也有一個 b，來正規化這個量。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Fair enough.
cues.zh: 這樣想很合理。

cues.en: And we're also missing a B up here.
cues.zh: 上面也少了一個 b。

cues.en: So we're missing a couple of B's here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡少了好幾個 b。

cues.en: But notice that this is a B up here.
cues.zh: 不過注意，上面有一個 b。

cues.en: Here we have b times b.
cues.zh: 這裡則是 b 乘 b。

cues.en: So that's b squared.
cues.zh: 也就是 b 平方。

cues.en: And then we take the square root of b squared which just gives us b.
cues.zh: 接著對 b 平方開平方根，就得到 b。

cues.en: And then the b in the numerator cancels out with the b in the denominator.
cues.zh: 於是分子的 b 與分母的 b 抵消。

cues.en: So in fact this normalization factor of one over n minus one technically is present in the correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 因此，嚴格來說，1 除以 N 減 1 這個正規化因子，確實存在於相關係數中。

cues.en: But it's there in the numerator and it's there in the denominator.
cues.zh: 不過分子與分母都有，

cues.en: And so they cancel each other out.
cues.zh: 所以彼此抵消。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now you see the the formula for covariance and the formula for correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 現在你已經看到共變異數與相關係數的公式。

cues.en: Now I also told you in the previous video that you cannot really just interpret a correlation coefficient on its own in terms of statistical significance.
cues.zh: 上一支影片也提過，不能光憑相關係數本身，解讀其統計顯著性。

cues.en: There's no magical R number that you can interpret as being different or not different from a correlation of zero.
cues.zh: 沒有哪個神奇的 r 值，可以直接判定它與零相關是否不同。

cues.en: So to compute a p value from a correlation, you apply this formula which actually gives you a t value.
cues.zh: 要從相關算出 P 值，可以套用這個公式，它實際上會先得到 t 值。

cues.en: And you would evaluate this t value with n minus two degrees of freedom along a t distribution.
cues.zh: 再沿著自由度 N 減 2 的 t 分布，評估這個 t 值。

cues.en: So the formula is r.
cues.zh: 公式是 r，

cues.en: This is the correlation coefficient times the square root of n minus two divided by one minus r squared.
cues.zh: 也就是相關係數，乘上 N 減 2 除以 1 減 r 平方之後的平方根。

cues.en: So as I've mentioned earlier in this course, when faced with a formula like this, what's useful to do is just fix one of these variables here.
cues.zh: 前面提過，面對這種公式時，一個有用的方法是先固定其中一個變數。

cues.en: So we have two variables that can vary r and n.
cues.zh: 這裡有 r 與 N 兩個可以變動的變數。

cues.en: So let's just fix one of them and then we'll consider what happens as the other one gets bigger or smaller.
cues.zh: 先固定其中一個，再考慮另一個變大或變小時會發生什麼事。

cues.en: So let's forget about R for the moment.
cues.zh: 暫時先不考慮 r。

cues.en: And so we just ignore R.
cues.zh: 先忽略 r。

cues.en: And we think about what happens when R is constant.
cues.zh: 想想 r 保持固定時會如何。

cues.en: So we can set R to be 0.5.
cues.zh: 可以把 r 設為 0.5。

cues.en: You can set R to be 0.0001.
cues.zh: 也可以設為 0.0001。

cues.en: It doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 都沒有關係。

cues.en: Just keep our fixed.
cues.zh: 只要讓 r 固定就好。

cues.en: So R is the same but now.
cues.zh: r 保持相同，但現在，

cues.en: So the strength of the relationship between the two variables is the same.
cues.zh: 也就是兩個變數之間的關係強度保持相同。

cues.en: But our sample size is growing, n is getting larger and larger and larger, and you can see what's going to happen to the t value.
cues.zh: 不過樣本大小增加，N 愈來愈大，可以看出 t 值會如何變化。

cues.en: Here the numerator gets larger and larger, but n is nowhere in the denominator.
cues.zh: 這裡的分子愈來愈大，但分母完全沒有 N。

cues.en: So there's nothing to scale it down.
cues.zh: 因此沒有東西把它縮小。

cues.en: So the exact same strength of relationship when a really large sample size is going to become increasingly significant.
cues.zh: 同樣強度的關係，在樣本數很大時，會變得愈來愈顯著。

cues.en: But you can also see that that's growing as a square root function.
cues.zh: 不過，也可以看到它是以平方根函數成長。

cues.en: So it's not that adding more data is going to give you a that doesn't produce a linear mapping.
cues.zh: 因此，增加資料不會產生線性對應。

cues.en: It's going to be a sublinear mapping.
cues.zh: 而是次線性的對應。

cues.en: So as you add more and more samples to your data, the t statistic is going to get larger.
cues.zh: 隨著資料中的樣本愈來愈多，t 統計量會變大。

cues.en: But as you add more data, the increase in the T is going to be smaller and smaller okay.
cues.zh: 但加入更多資料時，t 的增加幅度會愈來愈小。

cues.en: So that is for n.
cues.zh: 這是 N 的影響。

cues.en: So that's pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 相當直接。

cues.en: And now let's think about R.
cues.zh: 現在想想 r。

cues.en: So we know that R can vary between minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 我們知道，r 可以介於負 1 到正 1。

cues.en: Let's first think about when R starts at zero and starts getting towards one.
cues.zh: 先想想 r 從 0 開始，逐漸接近 1 的情況。

cues.en: So as R starts getting larger towards one, this numerator of this denominator is actually going to get smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: r 愈來愈大、接近 1 時，這個分子——其實是分母——會愈來愈小。

cues.en: And that's because when r gets closer to one r squared is also getting closer to one.
cues.zh: 因為 r 接近 1 時，r 平方也接近 1。

cues.en: And as r approaches one the denominator gets towards zero so that this ratio starts to get really really large.
cues.zh: r 趨近 1 時，分母趨近 0，所以這個比值開始變得非常大。

cues.en: In fact you can also see here that when r equals exactly one.
cues.zh: 事實上，也可以看到，當 r 精確等於 1，

cues.en: So you're correlating a variable with itself R squared of course is also one.
cues.zh: 也就是一個變數與自己相關時，r 平方當然也是 1。

cues.en: The denominator is zero.
cues.zh: 分母就是 0。

cues.en: And then well you know we just I don't know we just go to the beach and hang out for the day because you can't compute a T value of something over zero.
cues.zh: 那麼，我也不知道，就去海邊玩上一天吧，因為沒辦法計算某個量除以 0 的 t 值。

cues.en: Now let's also think about when R is negative and getting larger in magnitude but closer to minus one.
cues.zh: 再來想想，r 為負值，絕對值愈來愈大，逐漸接近負 1 的情況。

cues.en: So that would be a perfect inverse relationship.
cues.zh: 那會是完全的反向關係。

cues.en: So the numerator here becomes negative because of r is below zero.
cues.zh: 這裡的分子會變成負數，因為 r 小於 0。

cues.en: But here in this denominator we have r squared.
cues.zh: 但這個分母裡有 r 平方。

cues.en: So this term r squared is of course never going to be negative because well we don't consider imaginary or complex valued correlations.
cues.zh: r 平方當然絕不會是負數，因為我們不考慮虛數或複數值的相關。

cues.en: So R is always a real value.
cues.zh: 因此，r 總是實數。

cues.en: So when R is negative this is still positive.
cues.zh: r 為負時，這裡仍然是正的。

cues.en: So the denominator is still going to approach zero as r gets close to 1 or -1 okay.
cues.zh: 所以 r 接近 1 或負 1 時，分母仍然會趨近 0。

cues.en: So I hope that was helpful.
cues.zh: 希望這樣有幫助。

cues.en: I hope that builds a little bit of intuition about the relationship between R and N and the resulting t statistic.
cues.zh: 希望這讓你對 r、N 與得到的 t 統計量之間的關係，建立了一些直覺。

cues.en: And of course as the t statistic gets larger and larger, the p value is going to get smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: 當然，t 統計量愈來愈大，P 值就會愈來愈小。
